content: {"action":"appeal_with_necessity","reasoning":"The claim has a CO-197 denial, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review, so those routes are unavailable. Resubmission or records alone would not cure the missing authorization, while billing the secondary or patient is premature before exhausting the primary payer’s appeal path. File a formal medical-necessity appeal as the only available action that can properly contest the denial."}
